== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes will maintain this preparation out of combat.
{{bug|Heroes wielding a ranged weapon will target swap to new unpoisoned targets, but will not attack already poisoned ones.}}

== Notes ==
* This is the only preparation that affects [[weapon]]s besides [[bow]]s. 
* The condition is applied after the strike, making it valuable as a [[cover]] condition for skills such as [[Crippling Shot]] and [[Broad Head Arrow]].
* Physical attacks refers to attacks made by a [[martial weapon]], even those that deal non-physical damage.
